study_identification_part.si4_title: Patterns of connectome variability in autism across five functional activation tasks: findings from the LEAP project

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Characterize heterogeneity in autism by mapping individual-level atypicality in task-induced functional connectivity (task potency) across five fMRI tasks using normative modelling, and relate deviations to behavioral measures via robust CCA.

rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: The dataset from the EU-AIMS/AIMS2TRIALS LEAP project was used for the current analyses—a large multicenter European project…

rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: Participants performed a resting state fMRI (rs-fMRI)… and one or more of the following task-fMRI scans… Additionally, each participant completed an anatomical scan for the purpose of registration.

rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.answer: FSL; MCFLIRT; global intensity normalization; 6 mm smoothing; ICA-AROMA; WM/CSF regression; 0.01 Hz high-pass; FLIRT BBR to T1; FLIRT+FNIRT to MNI; inverse transform atlas to native; ComBat (site)
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.reason: Preprocessing explicitly details FSL pipeline steps and ComBat harmonization for linear site effects.
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.supporting_text: Preprocessing… performed with tools from FSL… volume realignment… MCFLIRT… global 4D mean intensity normalization and smoothing… ICA-AROMA… signal from white matter and cerebrospinal fluid was regressed out and we applied a 0.01 Hz high-pass filter… registered… using… FLIRT… FNIRT… We used the inverse of these transformations to take a brain atlas to the native space… ComBat was used to clean the data for linear site effects.

rci8_quality_checking.detail: >94% MNI overlap required; excluded 57 for <50% atlas-region overlap; excluded incidental findings/incomplete scans (N=18); excluded top 5% head motion by RMS FD (N=27); IQ < 75 excluded.
rci8_quality_checking.supporting_text: Participants were required to have acceptable overlap (> 94%) with the MNI152 standard brain… We then excluded 57 participants due to poor overlap (< 50%) with… ICP… excluded… incidental findings and incomplete scans (N = 18)… top 5%… head motion… (N = 27).

rci9_site_effect_handling.detail: ComBat harmonization by site across scanners/centres (KCL, RUNMC, UMCU, ARC/UCAM, CIMH; KI excluded), removing linear site effects from FC matrices; small changes observed (Supp. Fig. S4A–E).
rci9_site_effect_handling.supporting_text: …MRI data were acquired on 3T scanners at multiple sites… ComBat was used to clean the data for linear site effects… Figures with the mean FC matrices… with and without site correction…

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Robust out-of-sample CCA related functional connectivity atypicality patterns to behavioral measures (SRS, RBS, SSP, ADHD components, Vineland, IQ); group differences in atypicality assessed with independent t-tests (FDR-corrected) and Cohen's D.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: ASD shows greater deviation from normative functional connectivity across all tasks, with increased similarity of deviation patterns across individuals; atypicalities arise mainly in prefrontal, DMN, speech and auditory networks; FC atypicality covaries with autism-related behavior.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Deviation from normative ranges of global functional connectivity was greater for ASD vs TD in each task (all p < 0.001). Similarity across individuals of the deviation pattern was significantly increased in ASD relative to TD (p < 0.002). CCA identified significant brain–behavior covariation between FC atypicality and autism-related behavioral features. Atypicalities originated mostly from prefrontal cortex and default mode network regions, as well as speech and auditory networks.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Introduces a task potency approach (task minus rest connectivity) with mixture-model normalization; normative modelling using age/sex-adjusted reference (nispat, Python); ComBat site harmonization; robust out-of-sample CCA linking deviations to behavior.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Functional connectivity exhibits test–retest variability driven by factors such as traits, time of day, caffeine, medication, and task magnitude; while task potency uses each individual as their own baseline, remaining variability may affect FC fingerprints.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Five tasks: Hariri emotion, Flanker/Go-NoGo, social reward, non-social reward, Theory of Mind. ICP parcellation (168 regions, 11 networks). Partial correlations from regularized covariance; Fisher-Z; mixture Gaussian–gamma model normalization. Multi-echo EPI for rs-fMRI; 3T scanners at KCL, RUNMC, UMCU, ARC/UCAM, CIMH (KI excluded). Supplementary shows with/without ComBat site correction (small differences).
